title: sekhemet doctor --json
description: Every check of the install with its status and, when not a pass, its next step, and the verdict (surface items 20b, 20c).

exitCode.description: The exit code the command gives, with or without --json: 0 success, 1 failure, 2 a usage error or a missing confirmation.

ready.description: No check failed: Ready to run an issue (SUR-61).

verdict.description: Ready to run an issue, or Not ready naming the first missing step (SUR-61).

do.description: The next step, for a check that is not a pass (SUR-62).
